text: ＊は　わざマシンで　＊を　おぼえ　＊を　わすれた！

patterns.name: 〜連用形 (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut off before ます works like て in written style: it means 'and' and the sentence goes on. ＊を　おぼえ = 'learned ＊, and'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows the tool used to do something. わざマシンで = 'with a TM'.
